title: Lulu the Lamb's Colorful Fleece
description: A sweet story about a little lamb who learns to love her own simple wool just as it is.

scenes.narration: In a rolling green meadow, Lulu the lamb felt plain compared to the bright wildflowers blooming everywhere.
scenes.visual: fluffy white lamb standing in a meadow looking down at bright blue flowers

scenes.narration: She rubbed against a bush of ripe red berries, coloring her soft wool in bright crimson spots.
scenes.visual: cute lamb rubbing her white wool against a bush covered in glossy red berries

scenes.narration: At first she felt fancy, but soon the berries felt sticky and itchy in the warm afternoon sunshine.
scenes.visual: lamb looking uncomfortable and sticky with red patches on her fluffy coat

scenes.narration: Lulu trotted down to the cool, clear stream and washed away the squishy fruit from her soft wool.
scenes.visual: white lamb standing cheerfully in shallow clear water splashing gently

scenes.narration: Her mother wrapped her in a cozy hug, whispering how soft, clean, and warm her natural fleece truly was.
scenes.visual: mother sheep tenderly nuzzling her clean fluffy white lamb in the meadow

scenes.narration: Lulu smiled, realizing she was perfect and cuddly just the way she was made to be.
scenes.visual: happy white lamb smiling brightly under a warm golden sunset sky

scenes.narration: You are special just being you. Rest cozy tonight, and follow along for more sweet bedtime stories.
scenes.visual: little lamb snuggled comfortably in a soft barn bed sleeping peacefully
